Mixed fortnight desk minutes
The welfare meeting was held

Attendees were Amara Costa, Mei Davis, and Fluffy, with the team sitting in for a routine review of companion care on Aurelia Skyways.

The group opened with a check on passenger guidance, and the note was simple: keep booking notes clear, confirm travel fit early, and repeat the handoff steps so families know what to expect. Staff agreed that the Companion Animal Travel Desk should keep instructions calm and practical, with a focus on comfort, clean records, and steady communication from booking through pickup.

The team then reviewed cabin practice and onboard handling. <<FACT F038>> The discussion stayed focused on welfare, crate placement, and quick checks before departure, so there is less confusion at the gate. <<FACT F051>> The crew also asked for smoother coordination when a pet changes from desk care to flight care, and everyone agreed that the handover script should stay short and friendly. <<FACT F045>> That point was treated as a useful reminder for staff who answer questions from travelers and ground teams.

The meeting closed with a shared reminder to keep notes tidy, speak clearly, and keep each animal calm throughout the journey. The meeting ended with no further business.
